name: Batch Management Information 1
definition: Elements of identification of a batch management transaction.

CollectionIdentification.name: Collection Identification
CollectionIdentification.definition: Identification of the collection to which the batch belongs.||ISO 8583:2003 bit 69-2

BatchIdentification.name: Batch Identification
BatchIdentification.definition: Identification of the batch to which the message belongs.||ISO 8583:2003 bit 69-2

MessageSequenceNumber.name: Message Sequence Number
MessageSequenceNumber.definition: Sequence number of the message inside the batch.||ISO 8583:87/93 bit 71|ISO 8583:2003 bit 68-2

MessageChecksumInputValue.name: Message Checksum Input Value
MessageChecksumInputValue.definition: Value of the message to use for the computation of the checksum of the batch or collection of messages.
